# Compass (responsible-ai)

> Compass is the responsible AI, security and governance companion to the OASIS methodology — implementing Chapters 19 (Security and Responsible AI Engineering) and 20 (Governance, Compliance and Regulatory Engineering): the full policy and control catalog behind OASIS's defense-in-depth layers, plus jurisdiction-specific regulatory coverage.

See [Full Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/responsible-ai/main/INDEX.md), the [Framework Map](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/responsible-ai/main/00-navigation-and-methodology/framework-map.md), and the [Topic Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/responsible-ai/main/00-navigation-and-methodology/topic-index.md) for full navigation.

## Companion repositories

- [OASIS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS/main/llms.txt) — parent methodology (Chapters 19, 20 implemented here).
- [Helm](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/HELM/main/llms.txt) — runtime containment layer that enforces these controls in production.
- [Verity](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/VERITY/master/llms.txt) — tests whether the controls actually hold.
- [Ageis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/llms.txt), [Forge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Forge/master/llms.txt), [Loom](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/LOOM/master/llms.txt), [Fulcrum](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/llms.txt) — sibling chapter companions.
